About.title: About me
About.eyebrow: Frontend foundation plus three years of automation practice
About.lead: My strength is not one specific framework, but structured problem-solving with frontend fundamentals, AI and verification — from the first idea to a checked result.
paragraphs: My path started with a strong signal: after my degree in Economic Cybernetics (a ZAB-recognized bachelor's), I took 1st place among about 6,000 participants in the RS School / EPAM JS/FE Pre-School course — with pixel-perfect HTML/CSS work, matched against Figma files including messy ones, as my strongest discipline.

Since then, I have worked on my own software and automation projects every day for around three years — AI-assisted: I define the requirements, direct coding agents, verify the result in the real browser and debug through DevTools and network traffic analysis. 20+ projects and 100+ automated workflows, kept reliably in operation over months. When an unstable workflow directly costs money, verification becomes a habit.

Today I am aiming that combination at professional frontend / fullstack work. This portfolio is my current project: Next.js, multilingual, several live demos with real APIs, plus my own Playwright e2e suite that tests this very website in CI. I am actively rebuilding my web fundamentals (JavaScript, TypeScript, React) and speak openly about where I currently stand — I am looking for a junior frontend / fullstack role where I can deepen that.
